summary_en: Nice Co. to acquire Yamadai Corporation ordinary shares at ¥601 per share via tender offer from 2 June to 13 July 2026 (30 business days). Minimum acquisition 402,600 shares (36.24% post-acquisition stake). Purpose: complete subsidiary and delisting. Board recommends tendering. No maximum cap disclosed.
title_en: Notice of Board Opinion Supporting and Recommending Participation in Tender Offer for Company Shares by Nice Co., Ltd.
translation_en_brief: On 1 June 2026, Yamadai Corporation's board of directors announced its support for and recommendation of a tender offer launched by Nice Co., Ltd. to acquire Yamadai's ordinary shares at ¥601 per share. The offer period runs from 2 June to 13 July 2026 (30 business days). The minimum number of shares Nice intends to acquire is 402,600 shares, which would result in Nice holding 36.24% of Yamadai post-acquisition. No maximum acquisition cap is specified. The stated purpose is to make Yamadai a wholly owned subsidiary and to delist it from the Tokyo Stock Exchange. The board's decision is predicated on Nice's intent to complete a subsidiary status and subsequent delisting. Prior to this tender offer, the two companies had entered into a business partnership agreement on 9 January 2026 covering precut timber processing operations and domestically sourced lumber supply strengthening.
